A GPU devcoredump was captured after a Panthor crash. The dump includes the following key entries:

  GPU MMU fault: AS=2, FAULT_ADDR=0x7f3a000, TYPE=READ
  FAULT_STATUS=0x92 (PERMISSION_FAULT, OUTER_FAULT)
  Active CSF queue group: group_id=3, prio=HIGH, state=RUNNABLE
  Last dispatched job: job_id=1452, ring_buffer_offset=0x3c80
  Firmware state: MCU_STATUS=0x01 (ACTIVE)

How do I interpret the FAULT_STATUS=0x92 PERMISSION_FAULT for an OUTER fault? What does OUTER_FAULT mean in Mali GPU MMU terminology? How do I trace the faulty buffer mapping from the fault address back to the GPU VA allocation in the application?
